gold: Saturday night retinopathy with orbital compression syndrome

selector.rationale: Tense eyelid edema and severe disorganization of the retinal architecture support compressive optic neuropathy, which best explains the vision loss and other ocular findings without contradiction.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion

rejected.label: Rhabdomyolysis
rejected.why: Elevated creatine kinase level is not directly related to vision loss

rejected.label: Toxic optic neuropathy
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence to support toxic optic neuropathy as the primary cause
